query: query LoyaltyMemberHousehold($customerId: String, $memberId: String) {  loyaltyMemberHousehold(customerId: $customerId, memberId: $memberId) {  headOfHousehold {   memberNumber  customerId  firstName  lastName  memberStatus  associationDate  groupDocId  createdBy  createdOn }  householdHistory {    memberNumber  customerId  firstName  lastName   memberStatus  startDate  endDate  relationshipType   groupDocId  createdBy  lastUpdatedBy   lastUpdatedOn  }  householdMembers {    memberNumber customerId   firstName lastName   memberStatus  associationDate   groupDocId   lastUpdatedBy  lastUpdatedOn  createdBy  createdOn }} }
